ratios.quote: Our consolidated net leverage ratio as of the last day of any fiscal quarter may not exceed 4.25 to 1 in 2023, reducing to 4.00 to 1 in 2024 and thereafter.
Our consolidated interest coverage ratio may not be less than 3.00 to 1 as of the last day of any fiscal quarter.

parsed.notes: The filing does not disclose actual ratio values; it states only that the company was in compliance as of October 2, 2026. The net leverage limit stepped down from 4.25x in 2023 to 4.00x for 2024 and thereafter, so 4.00x applies at this date. The net leverage grids in the excerpt set interest margins and commitment fees only, so they were not treated as covenants.
